body:
Using a third state-dependent cavity line to calibrate one junction-shape parameter improves four unused ENS transmon drive predictions: errors change from +0.796,+2.899,+6.239,+11.008MHz to −0.218,−0.390,−0.951,−2.323MHz. The additional calibration observable prepares level2; the higher transitions remain excluded from fitting.

This is **open_gate / conditional-support**: a retrospective comparison of an imported one-transparency Andreev model with a four-input cosine baseline. It uses one extra measurement and parameter. It does not derive a native TOE correction, identify the mechanism uniquely, prove parameter uniqueness, or establish agreement within experimental errors. The highest-line residual, calibration condition number~203000 and charge-convention sensitivity remain explicit.

- [Scientific note](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/ens-cavity-holdout-20260927/docs/ENS_CAVITY_CALIBRATED_HOLDOUT_OPEN_GATE_NOTE_2026-09-27.md)
- [Primary runner](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/ens-cavity-holdout-20260927/scripts/ens_cavity_holdout_2026_09_27.py) and [authenticated computation](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/ens-cavity-holdout-20260927/logs/runner-cache/ens_cavity_holdout_2026_09_27.txt)

- [Conformance and verification limits](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/ens-cavity-holdout-20260927/.claude/science/physics-loops/ens-cavity-holdout-20260927/REVIEW_HISTORY.md)

The primary refits all three declared starts, preserves two nonconvergent attempts, and reads numerical evaluation values only after predictions and calibration controls are fixed. Independent raw-potential Fourier coefficients and a direct charge–photon basis reproduce the finer primary result within0.001Hz. The result survives the tested printed-decimal rounding corners; those finite controls are not statistical or continuous uncertainty bounds. The highest cavity line is sensitive to the unknown charge ensemble.

Validation: primary authenticated execution exit0 (24.10s), independent final-source check, vocabulary, Python compile, frozen-source hashes, complete source inspection and diff checks. Omitted harmonics,1% coupling and cavity-index faults are detected. Citation manifest adds exactly one node and no edges. Full pipeline, strict audit lint and changed-evidence checks remain for the exact integrated current-main landing candidate. No author merge or audit verdict; no primitive, prompt or skill changes. PR9348 and PR9351 remain separate and unchanged.
